FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Suliko Translation

quality.question: How accurate are the translations?
quality.answer: Suliko uses advanced AI models trained on professional translation corpora. Our accuracy rate is 98% for supported language pairs, and the editor lets you review and refine every segment before finalising your document.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: We currently support over 50 languages, including Georgian, English, French, Turkish, Polish, Ukrainian, Arabic, and many more. Georgian is a first-class citizen — our models are specifically fine-tuned for it.

formats.question: What file formats can I upload?
formats.answer: You can upload PNG, JPG, JPEG, PDF, DOCX, and TXT files. The document is parsed automatically and presented in a side-by-side editor so you can see the original alongside the translation.

pricing.question: Is there a free tier?
pricing.answer: Yes — every new user receives 25 free pages to translate. After that you can choose a monthly plan (Starter, Professional) or a pay-as-you-go option, whichever suits your workflow.

security.question: Is my document data secure?
security.answer: Your documents are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. We do not use your content to train our models, and you can request permanent deletion of your data at any time.

georgian.question: Why is Suliko especially good for Georgian?
georgian.answer: Georgian is a morphologically complex language that most general-purpose AI systems handle poorly. Suliko's models are fine-tuned on Georgian legal, medical, and business texts, resulting in significantly better output than generic translation services.

api.question: Do you offer an API or business integrations?
api.answer: Yes. Our Business and Enterprise plans include API access so you can integrate Suliko directly into your own workflows and applications. Contact our sales team for custom volume pricing and SLA options.

About.pageDescription: Who runs Suliko, what the service does, what it costs, and how to reach us.
About.title: About us
About.intro: Suliko is an AI translation service for documents and text. This page sets out who operates it, what it does, what it costs and how to contact us.
About.body:
1. The company

Suliko is operated by {name}, identification code {id}, registered in Georgia. We are the merchant of record for every payment made on suliko.ge and suliko.io, and the party responsible for delivering the service described below.

2. What the service does

Suliko translates documents and text between more than 60 languages. You upload a file — Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel, images or subtitles — or paste text directly, choose the target language, and receive a translation that keeps the original layout, tables and formatting.

The service is used for contracts, technical documentation, academic and medical papers, subtitles and everyday correspondence. Georgian is a first-class language throughout, including Georgian passports and identity documents.

A notarised translation option is available for documents that need legal certification in Georgia.

3. How it works

Create an account, top up your balance, upload a document and choose the target language. Translation usually completes in under a minute for an ordinary document; large files take proportionally longer. Finished translations stay in your history and can be downloaded again at any time.

4. What it costs

All prices are in Georgian lari (GEL, ₾), and that is the currency charged at checkout on both suliko.ge and suliko.io.

Pay as you go — 1 ₾ per page. Buy any amount from 1 ₾ upwards.

Starter — 20 ₾ for 100 pages.

Professional — 50 ₾ for 500 pages.

A page means one standard page of translated text. Pages do not expire and can be used whenever you need them. There is no subscription and no recurring charge: you are billed only for what you buy, at the moment you buy it.

5. Contact

Email: {email}
Phone: {phone}
Address: {address}

We answer support enquiries by email within one business day.

RefundPolicy.pageDescription: How translation credits are delivered, and how to cancel an order or request a refund.
RefundPolicy.title: Delivery, cancellation and refund policy
RefundPolicy.intro: This policy covers what you receive when you pay, when an order can be cancelled, and when we refund. It applies to purchases made on suliko.ge and suliko.io. Both sites are operated by {name} (identification code: {id}).
RefundPolicy.body:
1. What you are buying

You are buying translation credits, measured in pages, which are added to your account balance. Nothing is shipped: the service is delivered entirely online.

2. Delivery

Credits are added to your account as soon as the bank confirms your payment — normally within seconds. If your balance has not updated within 15 minutes of a successful payment, contact us at {email} with the date and amount and we will apply the credits manually.

There is no delivery charge, because there is nothing to deliver physically.

3. Cancelling before you pay

You can abandon a payment at any point before you confirm it on the bank's page. Nothing is charged and no order is created. Closing the payment page, or letting it expire, cancels the order by itself.

4. Refunds

Unused credits are refundable in full for 14 days from the date of purchase. We will refund the amount paid to the card used for the purchase.

Credits you have already spent on a completed translation are not refundable, because the service has been performed and delivered.

If a translation fails for a technical reason on our side, the credits for it are returned to your balance automatically. If that does not happen, tell us and we will restore them.

If you were charged twice for the same order, or charged after a payment that visibly failed, we refund the duplicate in full regardless of how long ago it happened.

5. How to request a refund

Email {email} from the address on your account, telling us the date of the purchase, the amount, and briefly why you are asking. You do not need to give a reason for a refund of unused credits within 14 days.

We reply to every refund request within 3 business days. Approved refunds are sent back to the original card within 10 business days; how quickly it then appears on your statement is up to your bank.

6. Problems with a translation

If a translation is wrong, incomplete or unusable, tell us within 14 days and we will re-run it at no cost, or refund the credits it consumed if we cannot put it right.

7. Disputes

If something has gone wrong with a payment, please contact us first at {email} or {phone} — we can almost always resolve it faster than a card dispute can. Raising a chargeback with your bank remains your right and does not affect the rights described above.

Privacy.pageDescription: What Suliko collects, why, how long it is kept, and what you can ask us to do with it.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Suliko collects, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and the choices you have. It applies to suliko.ge and suliko.io.
Privacy.body:
1. Who is responsible

{name} is the controller of the personal data described here. You can reach us at {email}, or by post at {address}.

2. What we collect

Account details: your email address, and your phone number if you register with one. A password, stored only as a cryptographic hash that cannot be reversed.

Content you submit: documents and text you upload for translation, and the translations produced from them.

Usage records: pages translated, language pairs, timestamps and balance movements — what we need to bill correctly and to show your history.

Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, collected in ordinary server logs.

3. Documents you upload

Your documents are yours. We process them to produce your translation and to keep it available in your history, and for nothing else. We do not sell them, we do not publish them, and we do not use their contents to train models.

Translation is performed using Google's Gemini API. Your document text is sent to that service for the sole purpose of translating it, under Google's terms for API customers, which do not permit its use for training.

4. Payment data

Card payments are processed by the Bank of Georgia. Card numbers, expiry dates and security codes are entered on the bank's own page and are never sent to, seen by, or stored by us. We keep only the order reference, the amount, the currency and whether the payment succeeded.

5. How long we keep it

Documents and translations stay in your history until you delete them or close your account.

Account records are kept while your account is open. When you close it, we delete your account and content within 30 days.

Payment and invoicing records are kept for as long as Georgian accounting and tax law requires, which is longer than the periods above and applies even after an account is closed.

6. Who else sees it

We share personal data only with the providers needed to run the service: our hosting provider, the Gemini API for translation, and the Bank of Georgia for payments. Each receives only what its task requires.

We disclose data to authorities only where the law obliges us to, and we do not sell personal data to anyone.

7. Your rights

You can ask us to give you a copy of your data, correct it, delete it, or stop processing it. Write to {email} from the address on your account and we will respond within 30 days.

You can delete individual documents from your history yourself at any time, and you can close your account whenever you like.

8. Cookies

We use cookies that are necessary for the site to work — keeping you signed in, and remembering your language and theme. We do not use advertising cookies. Analytics, where used, is limited to aggregate traffic measurement.

9. Security

Traffic to and from the site is encrypted in transit. Passwords are hashed. Access to production data is limited to the people who need it to operate the service.

10. Changes

If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page. Material changes will be announced on the site before they take effect.

11. Contact

Questions about privacy: {email}.
